blocks.text:
Day 1    Balmaceda – Puerto Río Tranquilo · 220 km, about 4 hours

Day 1 · Arrival at Balmaceda Airport and welcome by your local English-speaking driver-guide. The journey begins along the legendary Carretera Austral, heading south through the wide-open Patagonian steppe and the vast valleys of the Aysén region. Little by little, arid plains give way to forested slopes, until the road reveals the brilliant turquoise waters of Lago General Carrera. Arrival in Puerto Río Tranquilo.

Overnight: El Puesto Patagonia
